title: Treating the Symptom, Missing the Cause: Anatomy of a Scientific Reasoning Failure
title_zh: 治标不治本：一次科学推理失败的剖析

paragraphs.en: 研究发现大模型智能体能挽救生物体却难以诊断隐藏故障，根源是无法预测竞争原因下的实验预期结果。 Scientific agents can find interventions that work without understanding why they do. We study this failure mode in controlled synthetic regulatory systems, where agents must experimentally identify a hidden fault and rescue the resulting phenotype. Across seven LLMs, every model restores the healthy phenotypes more often than it identifies the fault. Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 rescue every organism while diagnosing only 55% and 35% of them. This failure is not simply due to insufficient exploration or unavailable evidence. In most cases, the cause is experimentally identifiable, and agents encounter evidence that distinguishes competing causes in 91% of relevant sessions, and still frequently misdiagnose the system. Targeted probes reveal where experimental reasoning breaks down. Models reliably interpret decisive evidence and revise hypotheses when the causal comparison is explicit, and can locate that evidence within a full experimental record. However, they struggle to predict the outcome of the experiment under each competing cause, a necessary step in using the observed result to distinguish between them. Agents can therefore gather the right evidence and still infer the wrong cause. As AI systems take on a growing role in synthesising scientific evidence, these findings highlight the need to evaluate how they use evidence to reach causal conclusions, alongside whether their interventions succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现大模型智能体能挽救生物体却难以诊断隐藏故障，根源是无法预测竞争原因下的实验预期结果。科学智能体能够找到有效的干预手段，却不理解这些手段为何有效。 我们在受控的合成调控系统中研究这种失败模式，智能体必须通过实验识别隐藏故障并挽救由此产生的表型。 在七个大模型中，每个模型恢复健康表型的频率都高于识别故障的频率。 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 能挽救所有生物体，但诊断成功率仅为 55% 和 35%。 这一失败并非仅仅源于探索不足或证据不可获取。 在大多数情况下，原因可以通过实验识别，智能体在 91% 的相关会话中遇到过能够区分竞争原因的证据，但仍然经常误诊系统。 针对性探针揭示了实验推理在何处失效。 当因果比较是显式给出时，模型能够可靠地解读决定性证据并修正假设，并且能够在完整的实验记录中定位该证据。 然而，它们难以预测在每种竞争原因下实验的结果，而这是利用观测结果区分这些原因的必要步骤。 因此，智能体能够收集到正确的证据，却仍然推断出错误的原因。 随着人工智能系统在综合科学证据方面扮演越来越重要的角色，这些发现凸显了评估它们如何利用证据得出因果结论的必要性，而不仅仅评估其干预是否成功。
